meta.name: github-actions-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, building, and deploying applications. Use when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or creating reusable workflow templates.

copy.tagline: 搭好自动化测试构建部署流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想用GitHub Actions把测试部署流程模板化
copy.tagline_en: Set up automated test, build, and deploy pipelines with GitHub Actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to templatize your testing and deployment workflows on GitHub Actions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你写出可直接用的 GitHub Actions 工作流 YAML 文件,覆盖自动测试、构建并推送 Docker 镜像、部署到 Kubernetes、跑安全扫描、多环境矩阵构建等场景,产出包含权限、缓存、密钥引用等配置的完整 workflow。
howto.when: 当你用 GitHub Actions 搭建 CI/CD、自动化开发流程,或需要可复用的 workflow 模板时进入;正文还覆盖安全扫描、矩阵构建等场景。

say.text: 生成一个构建 Docker 镜像并推送到 ghcr.io 的工作流
say.note: 含登录镜像仓库、提取标签、构建推送步骤

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes ready-to-use GitHub Actions workflow YAML: automated testing, building and pushing Docker images, Kubernetes deploys, security scans, and matrix builds, with permissions, caching and secrets wired in.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or creating reusable workflow templates; it also covers security scans and matrix builds.

say_en.text: Write a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests on push to main
say_en.note: Produces a Test workflow with lint, tests, coverage upload

say_en.text: Generate a workflow that builds a Docker image and pushes it to ghcr.io
say_en.note: Includes registry login, tag metadata, build and push steps

say_en.text: Use a matrix build to test on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows with Python 3.9-3.12
say_en.note: Creates a cross-OS, cross-version matrix build config
